item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find a single 2024 manifesto that cleanly sets out the whole ideology in one place. The clearest evidence is fragmented across the March and May development documents, the June war-aim speech, and the November nuclear doctrine. That makes the program legible, but the fragmentation limits confidence about any single, stable doctrine beyond sovereignty, security, and regime control.","evidence":[{"title":"Executive Order on Russia’s development goals through 2030 and for the future until 2036","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-07","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986","summary":"Sets an explicit national program: sovereign economic development, population growth, fair competition, private initiative, technological effectiveness, and annual priority budget allocations.
